name: 1.23.0-beta.18
notes: RPG Maker MV/MZ games: leaving with ×, locking, or switching away from the app now saves the game (while you are walking around on the map) in a save slot of the app's own, past the game's last slot, so none of your own saves is ever replaced.
Their page has a Continue button that starts straight from your newest save, the app's or one you made in the game.
